map.比准单价 = 可比实例单价 × (1 + 交易情况修正%) × (1 + 区域因: Adjusted unit price = comparable unit price × (1 + transaction adjustment%) × (1 + location adjustment%) × (1 + property adjustment%); total value = adjusted unit price × gross floor area. A positive adjustment means the subject is superior to the comparable, negative means inferior.

map.修正率为正是把可比实例价格向上修正到估价对象水平（估价对象更优）；为负则向下修正: A positive rate adjusts the comparable upward to the subject's level (subject is superior); a negative rate adjusts downward. The three rates multiply rather than add, avoiding overstated adjustments.
